features.name: Power or Speed
features.description:
At 1st level, a generalist begins learning how to control herself and by extension, the flow of combat. The generalist can take a -2 penalty on attack, damage or AC and get an equal bonus to one of the others. The generalist must choose to use this ability before making an attack roll, and its effects last until her next turn.

This ability replaces spell combat.
Manual sheet handling: record any stated choice, companion, weapon, spell, feat, temporary modifier or condition on the existing sheet entries; this card does not apply global combat effects.

features.name: Multitalented
features.description:
At 2nd level, a generalist picks up on a little bit of everything, and can use sheer luck or force of will to appear competent at just about anything. The generalist can make skill checks untrained and may spend an arcane point to reroll a failed skill check with a bonus equal to her Charisma modifier once per round. The skill check cannot take more than 1 round.

This ability replaces spellstrike.
Manual sheet handling: record any stated choice, companion, weapon, spell, feat, temporary modifier or condition on the existing sheet entries; this card does not apply global combat effects.

features.name: Magic Mastery
features.description:
At 5th level, the generalist continues her mastery on controlling every aspect of her being, learning how to better utilize her magic. As a [swift action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#swift) that lasts a number of rounds equal to the generalist’s Charisma modifier (minimum 1) and costs an arcane point, the generalist can choose to take a penalty on healing or damaging spells equal to her Charisma modifier (minimum 1) and apply an equal bonus to the other.

This ability replaces convert.
Manual sheet handling: record any stated choice, companion, weapon, spell, feat, temporary modifier or condition on the existing sheet entries; this card does not apply global combat effects.

features.name: Spellblade
features.description:
At 7th level, the generalist learns to blend both styles of combat into one. When casting a damaging or enfeebling spell, she can make a single weapon attack on the same target as a [swift action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#swift). When casting a healing or enhancing spell on an ally, she can make a single weapon attack on the foe closest to her if within range. At 16th level, this ability gains an insight bonus on attack and damage equal to the level of the spell cast prior to it.

This ability replaces improved spell combat and counterstrike.
Manual sheet handling: record any stated choice, companion, weapon, spell, feat, temporary modifier or condition on the existing sheet entries; this card does not apply global combat effects.

features.name: Aspect of the Ruby
features.description:
At 11th level, the generalist hits a new milestone when it comes to full coverage. At the cost of an arcane point, a [swift action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#swift), and MP equal to the highest spell level she knows, the generalist can emulate one of three aspects perfectly for a number of rounds equal to her Charisma modifier.

* *Shield ([Su](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#supernatural)):* The generalist gains a deflection bonus to AC equal to the MP expended when using this ability, and half that bonus (rounded down) to all saving throws.
* *Staff ([Su](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#supernatural)):* The generalist gains a morale bonus to her ruby knowledge bonus equal to the MP expended when using this ability, and half this bonus is added to spell resistance checks and red mage spell save DCs.
* *Sword ([Su](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#supernatural)):* The generalist gets a morale bonus to attack and damage rolls with a held weapon equal to the MP expended when using this ability. Her held weapons’ critical threat range is increased by half this bonus (rounded down). This does not stack with other abilities that increase a weapon’s critical threat range.

This ability replaces jack-of-all-trades.
Manual sheet handling: record any stated choice, companion, weapon, spell, feat, temporary modifier or condition on the existing sheet entries; this card does not apply global combat effects.

features.name: Renaissance Man
features.description:
At 14th level, the generalist makes ‘Jack-of-all-Trades’ look like a dunce and laughs in his face about it. When making an untrained skill check or using the multitalented ability, the generalist can act as if she had a number of ranks in the skill equal to half her class level, and benefits from a +3 bonus as if it were a class skill.

This ability replaces greater spell combat.
Manual sheet handling: record any stated choice, companion, weapon, spell, feat, temporary modifier or condition on the existing sheet entries; this card does not apply global combat effects.

features.name: Generalist Mastery
features.description:
At 20th level, the generalist doesn’t care about any one aspect of their character to exemplify it above the rest. When using power or speed, magic mastery, or spellblade, the bonuses gained are all increased by +2.

This ability replaces red wizard.
Manual sheet handling: record any stated choice, companion, weapon, spell, feat, temporary modifier or condition on the existing sheet entries; this card does not apply global combat effects.
